title: Token Standards and Reusable Contract Libraries
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Token Standards and Reusable Contract Libraries and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 12: Token Standards and Reusable Contract Libraries; it lists all 16 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 12 roadmap: Introduction to Ethereum Application Standards; Understanding ERC Standards and Their Purpose; ERC-20 Fungible Tokens; ERC-20 Balances, Allowances, and Transfers; Token Minting, Burning, and Supply Limits; ERC-721 Non-Fungible Tokens; ERC-721 Ownership and Safe Transfers; ERC-1155 Multi-Token Contracts; ERC-165 Interface Detection; ERC-2612 Permit and Signature-Based Approvals; Token Metadata and URI Design; OpenZeppelin Contracts: Setup and Usage; Ownership and Access-Control Utilities; Pausable Contracts and Emergency Controls; Reentrancy Protection Utilities; Inheriting, Extending, and Customizing Standard Contracts. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
